**Answer: α = 2**, but I could not verify this from a derivation or a source, so treat it as a best recollection.

I did not work through a proof of either direction. My recollection is that a recent result on tree decompositions with spread bounded by vertex degree shows:

- For every c < 2, some graph G has no tree decomposition of width at most c·tw(G) in which every vertex satisfies s(v) ≤ c′(d(v)+1). So P(c) fails for all c < 2.
- Width 2·tw(G) is achievable with such a spread bound, so the threshold is exactly 2.

ANSWER: 2
